My Dearest Princess

Thank you for being you… for making my days brighter, for filling my life with love, and for being my favourite person.

From silly late-night talks to the quiet moments when you understand me without a single word, every memory with you is my favourite chapter.

You have a heart softer than clouds and a smile that can fix the worst of days. Somehow you turn ordinary moments into magic, and I hope you always see yourself the way I see you.

You mean more to me than words can say, and I’m so lucky to have you.

On your day, I wish you all the love, laughter, sweet surprises and peace that you give to everyone around you. Whenever the world feels heavy, remember that I’m only one call away, always on your side and always your biggest fan.

I hope you always keep smiling, because you deserve all the love and happiness in this world.

Forever Yours ♡
